description: This file implements the GrainCancellationTokenRuntime class responsible for managing cancellation tokens for grains, including cancellation logic with retries, and serialization support for GrainCancellationToken objects.

classes.name: GrainCancellationTokenRuntime
classes.description: Handles cancellation logic for grains, including executing remote cancellation with retries and exception filtering.

classes.name: GrainCancellationTokenCodec
classes.description: Serializer for converting GrainCancellationToken to and from its surrogate form for serialization purposes.

classes.name: GrainCancellationTokenSurrogate
classes.description: Data structure used as a surrogate for serializing GrainCancellationToken instances.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels a grain's cancellation token and propagates the cancellation to related grain references, with retry logic.

methods.name: CancelTokenWithRetries
methods.description: Performs remote token cancellation with retries and removes the grain reference from the collection.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate object into a GrainCancellationToken.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a GrainCancellationToken into its surrogate form for serialization.
